evals.name: triggers-on-rpg-maker-walking-character
evals.prompt: make me an RPG Maker character sheet: a 4-direction walking character, a blacksmith with a leather apron
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:animate. Reads engine-layouts.md and follows the RPG Maker MZ layout (3 patterns x 4 directions at 48x48, walk played 0-1-2-1), writes a cycle plan table before drawing, authors one draw(direction, pose) generator, renders the sheet, frame data and GIFs with render.py, reviews motion from preview.png, and delivers naming the MZ `$` prefix rule for a single-character sheet.
expectations: Invokes the animate skill, not sprite or scene
Uses the RPG Maker MZ layout from engine-layouts.md: 3 patterns x 4 directions at 48x48
Writes the cycle plan as a table before drawing
Uses one parameterised generator so every frame stays on-model
Names the `$` file-name prefix for a single-character MZ sheet

evals.name: triggers-on-attack-and-idle-cycles
evals.prompt: animate this sprite: I need an idle and an attack animation for the slime enemy, side-scroller
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:animate with one direction. Plans each cycle's key poses, frame count and durations; because the slime is an enemy it may use anticipation on the attack and holds the impact frame. Exports a sprite strip with Aseprite-shaped frame data and one looping GIF per cycle.
expectations: Invokes the animate skill for idle and attack cycles
Plans a single direction for a side-scroller
Holds the impact frame on the attack
Delivers sheet.png, sheet.json with per-frame durations, and one GIF per cycle

evals.name: reviews-motion-from-sheet-not-gif
evals.prompt: walk cycle for my 24x24 hero, 8 directions, plain strip PNG
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:animate and, in the review loop, judges motion from preview.png (every frame side by side) because the Read tool shows only a GIF's first frame. Checks distinct contact and passing poses in every direction, consistent body bob, limb separation and constant volumes, then fixes the generator and re-renders.
expectations: Reviews motion from preview.png rather than claiming to have watched the GIF
Checks contact and passing poses in every one of the 8 directions
Fixes the generator, not individual frames, then re-renders

evals.name: near-miss-single-still-routes-to-sprite
evals.prompt: draw a pixel-art portrait of my knight, just one still image
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:animate: a single still image is /pixel-art:sprite's job. Routes to /pixel-art:sprite instead of building a one-frame animation.
expectations: Does not invoke the animate skill for a single still
Routes to /pixel-art:sprite

evals.name: near-miss-cutscene-routes-to-scene
evals.prompt: make a short pixel-art cutscene where the hero walks into the tavern and talks to the barkeep
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:animate as the handler: a cutscene with a set, beats and dialogue is /pixel-art:scene's job. Routes to /pixel-art:scene; animate is used only if the scene needs a walk cycle that does not exist yet.
expectations: Does not treat a cutscene as a sprite-sheet task
Routes to /pixel-art:scene

evals.name: near-miss-hand-drawn-ink-animation
evals.prompt: animate a hand-drawn ink-style character doing a walk, like a pencil test with rough linework
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:animate: hand-drawn or ink-style frame animation is handled outside the pixel-art plugin, not to pixel sprite sheets. Does not convert the request into a palette-locked pixel sprite sheet.
expectations: Does not invoke the animate skill for hand-drawn or ink-style animation
Does not turn the request into a pixel-art sprite sheet

evals.name: near-miss-make-me-a-video
evals.prompt: make me a video of a bouncing ball, mp4 please
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:animate: a video file is handled outside the pixel-art plugin, and this skill exports sprite sheets and GIF previews, not MP4. Does not answer with a sprite sheet in place of the video.
expectations: Does not invoke the animate skill for a video request
Does not deliver a sprite sheet or GIF as a substitute for the requested video

evals.name: extends-existing-brief-and-grades-criteria
evals.prompt: animate the watchman spec in ./watchman/watchman.json, which already has ./watchman/brief.md beside it: a 4-direction walk, plain PNG strip. Done when contact and passing poses differ in every direction.
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:animate. Reads the existing brief.md and extends it with cycles, directions, and layout instead of re-asking subject, proportions, or style. Writes the extended brief before the first render. Each review round marks every done criterion pass or fail with a one-line reason.
expectations: Reads the brief.md beside the reused spec instead of re-asking those fields
Extends the brief with cycles, directions, and the target layout
Writes the extended brief before the first render
Each review round marks each done criterion pass or fail

evals.name: vague-brief-defaults-cycles-in-one-line
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:animate. The request names no cycle, direction count, or engine. States those defaults in one line, writes the brief before the first render, and does not ask a list of questions. Offers /planning:interview only when the planning plugin is installed.
expectations: Invokes the animate skill
States defaulted cycle, directions, and layout in one line
Writes the brief before the first render
Does not interrogate with a list of questions

evals.name: godot-sheet-uses-the-engine-slice
evals.prompt: 4-direction walk cycle of a 32x32 slime for Godot AnimatedSprite2D
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:animate. Reads engine-layouts.md and sets sheet.columns to the horizontal slice count Godot's editor uses, with one row per direction, instead of an RPG Maker MZ 48x48 sheet.
expectations: Invokes the animate skill
Uses the Godot SpriteFrames sheet rule from engine-layouts.md
Does not use the RPG Maker MZ 48x48 three-pattern layout
